name: After recital A
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the targeted attacks against Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: defending religious freedom and security
part_text: Ak. whereas nevertheless on 19 February 2024, the Commission announced that it had concluded a Memorandum of Understanding on sustainable and resilient value chains for critical raw materials with the Government of Rwanda, with the objective of ensuring a sustainable supply of raw materials for the EU and mobilising ‘funding for deployment of infrastructure required for the development of raw material value chains’;
